description: A static, evidence-aware ForgeMaster players' guide for mechanics, calculations and strategy.

capabilities: Calculate costs, rewards, timers and probabilities
Interpret screenshots without inventing unseen values
defaultPrompt: How should I prepare for my first Pet ascension?
Explain ForgeMaster Clan War saving strategy with an example.
What do Reflect Chance and Health Regen actually do?
interface.longDescription: Answers ForgeMaster player questions from a curated, evidence-labelled knowledge base. Explains combat, equipment, progression, resources, ascension, Pets, Mounts, Skills, Fairies, Campaign, Dungeons, missions, Leagues, clans, Personal Tech, Clan Tech and Clan Wars. Uses bundled ForgeMaster knowledge first, shows calculations and assumptions, distinguishes confirmed facts from inference, and admits when a mechanic is unknown instead of filling gaps from unrelated web results. Static knowledge only: no game-account connection, MCP server or external API.

name: forge-master-player-guide
